<section_guide number="7" title="PoC Validation Plan">
<purpose>Define how the PoC will demonstrate the scenario and produce evidence for the approved success criteria.</purpose>

<questions>
1. What is the shortest demo that reaches the Primary User Scenario's completion result?
2. What evidence would make each Feature and success criterion pass or fail?
</questions>

<workflow>
Create one validation row per Feature completion checkpoint and success criterion. Use results a
reviewer or participant can observe in the PoC. Mark anything the PoC cannot test as "Not yet
testable" rather than inventing evidence. Keep feedback questions focused on comprehension,
usefulness, trust, and the highest-impact assumption.
</workflow>

<completion required="true">Confirm the demo flow, complete validation checklist, and feedback questions before saving.</completion>
</section_guide>
